# #205 item 1: the status checks branch protection requires on main.
#
# One job display name per line, exactly as `name:` spells it in the workflow.
# Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored. This file is the source of truth:
#
#   - tests/branch-protection.test.mts fails if a gating job in .github/workflows
#     is missing here, if an entry matches no job name (a rename or a typo), or
#     if a `continue-on-error` job is listed as required. This runs on every
#     test run and is the half that is actually automated.
#   - scripts/required-checks.mjs compares this list against the live branch
#     protection rule, catching a change made in the GitHub UI that nobody
#     committed here. Run it BY HAND (`GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) node
#     scripts/required-checks.mjs`): it cannot be a ci.yml step, because reading
#     branch protection needs the `administration` permission and a job's
#     GITHUB_TOKEN cannot be granted it.
#
# `E2E hosted checkout (best effort)` is deliberately absent: it is
# `continue-on-error`, so requiring it would gate merges on a check that is
# designed not to block. Required gates that do block are listed below.
Lint & test
Workflow audit
E2E smoke flow
E2E Worker runtime
